cohort: 233 first-time mothers who had undergone cesarean sections
finding: The discharge readiness of first-time mothers who underwent cesarean section was at a moderate level and was negatively correlated with age and complications after cesarean section, while positively correlated with the quality of discharge teaching.
mod_finding: This study focuses on the discharge readiness of first-time mothers who underwent cesarean section, not specifically on the mode of delivery itself.
